# WO-2026-08-12-B15-VISION-PROTOTYPE-01 — Agentic vision loop prototype

## Acceptance criteria

AC1: **Add `/v1/responses` support to `models.mjs`** — a new exported function (do not overload the
existing `vision()`, which stays exactly as-is for every other caller). Must support: an image input,
household context, a tool definition (`request_crop(region: string)`), and accepting a
`previous_response_id` to continue an existing server-side conversation without resending prior history.
Base this on the capability audit's own confirmed real requests
(`Deliverables/2026-08-12-gateway-capability-audit-and-agentic-loop-design.md` — the probe scripts
referenced there, in this session's scratchpad, are real evidence of the working request shape; read
them for the actual wire format, don't re-derive it from OpenAI's generic public docs).

AC2: **Build the standalone loop** in `services/asdair/pipeline/agenticVisionPrototype/` — NOT imported
by or wired into `interpretPhotoOrchestrator.js`, `deps.js`, `runPipeline.js` or any other production
call site. Shape: send the prepared full photo + numbered regions + household Regulars/Favourites/
aliases context (prompt-cached, per the audit's confirmed ~90% cache-hit discount) + the `request_crop`
tool + an instruction to keep inspecting until confident the whole page is covered, not just the first
pass. On a `request_crop` tool call, supply the requested region's crop as the next turn, chained via
`previous_response_id` — genuine continuation, no resent history. Repeat until Terra stops requesting
crops or the iteration cap is hit.

AC3: **Hard iteration cap, enforced and tested** — propose 4 as the default maximum tool-call rounds
(name it clearly as a named constant, easily changed, not a magic number); prove with a test that the
loop actually stops and returns its best-effort result at the cap rather than looping unboundedly, using
a mocked model response that always requests another crop.

AC4: **Fix the stale pricing constant** in `models.mjs` — the audit found the live gateway bills
`gpt-5.6-terra` at $2.50/$15 per million input/output tokens; the code currently assumes $2.00/$12 and
labels the correct figure as superseded. Correct it; do not just flip a comment, verify the constant
actually used by `estimateUsdCost()` changes.

AC5: **A runnable script**, callable by Asdair against the real gateway (you do not run it — no
credentials, same as every prior round), that exercises this prototype against the one known photograph
and reports: how many tool-call rounds fired, the real per-turn usage/cost via `estimateUsdCost()`, and
the final structured line list with `source_region` provenance on every line — same shape the production
pipeline's own provenance discipline expects, even though this prototype writes to no database.

AC6: All new code has unit tests with mocked model responses (a fresh vision call, a tool-call response,
a final-answer response, and the iteration-cap case) — non-zero executed count, no live gateway call
anywhere in this WP's own test run.

## Required evidence

- The exact new `/v1/responses` request/response shape your code sends and expects, cited against the
  audit's own probe evidence.
- AC3's iteration-cap test output, pasted.
- Confirmation `estimateUsdCost()` now uses the corrected pricing (AC4), with a before/after number for
  the same token count.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/obsidiwikai/src/core/models.mjs services/asdair/pipeline/agenticVisionPrototype` → exit code and coverage.

## Inputs supplied

- `Deliverables/2026-08-12-gateway-capability-audit-and-agentic-loop-design.md` — the full capability
  findings and the architecture this WP implements a prototype of.
- `Deliverables/2026-08-12-vision-pipeline-six-round-reconciliation.md` — why this approach was chosen
  over another symptom-fix round.
- The capability audit's real probe scripts and results, this session's shared scratchpad — the actual
  proven request/response shapes for `/v1/responses` and tool-calling on this specific gateway.
- `services/obsidiwikai/src/core/models.mjs`'s existing `vision()`/`gatewayChat` — read for the existing
  conventions (auth header, error handling, usage capture) before adding the new function; match the
  established style, don't invent a divergent one.

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- Wiring this into the production pipeline (`interpretPhotoOrchestrator.js`, `deps.js`, `runPipeline.js`)
  — that is a LATER decision, only after the prototype is proven live against the known photo.
- Running the prototype against the live gateway yourself — Asdair's job, once this lands.
- The existing production vision pipeline (`services/asdair/pipeline/interpretPhotoOrchestrator.js` and
  everything six rounds already built) — untouched, still the production path, unaffected by this
  prototype existing.
- Any live shop, browser, or basket-build action.
- `services/cockpit/**` and `services/asdair/cockpit-api/**` — unrelated.

## Sequencing

1. Standard gate: read back (outcome, plan, what this order failed to settle, what looks wrong) and HOLD for Larry's explicit acceptance before writing any code.
2. On acceptance: AC1 (gateway function) and AC4 (pricing fix) first — both are foundational and independent of the loop logic itself. Then AC2/AC3 (the loop). Then AC5/AC6.
3. Report completion with the required evidence above. Larry will then dispatch Asdair to run AC5's script against the real gateway and the known photograph — the actual proof this whole redirect exists to obtain.
